import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:luxo_client/luxo_client.dart' as sdk;
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:http/testing.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

import 'types.dart';
import 'client.dart';

const socketEndpoint = '__MODEL_DEPTH_WS__';

Object? jsonValue(int layers) {
  Object? value;
  for (var i = 0; i < layers; i++) value = [value];
  return value;
}

Map<String, dynamic> jsonNode(int layers, {bool lists = false}) {
  var node = <String, dynamic>{'metadata': jsonValue(128), 'children': []};
  for (var i = 1; i < layers; i++) {
    node = lists
        ? {
            'children': [node],
          }
        : {'child': node};
  }
  return node;
}

Uint8List wireNode(
  int layers, {
  bool columnar = false,
  bool lists = false,
  int count = 1,
  int jsonDepth = 128,
}) {
  final value = layers == 1
      ? Uint8List.fromList(
          utf8.encode('${'[' * jsonDepth}null${']' * jsonDepth}'),
        )
      : wireNode(
          layers - 1,
          columnar: lists,
          lists: lists,
          jsonDepth: jsonDepth,
        );
  final encoder = sdk.LuxoEncoder();
  if (columnar) encoder.writeVarint(count);
  encoder.writeVarint(0);
  encoder.writeVarint(
    layers == 1
        ? 3
        : lists
        ? 2
        : 1,
  );
  for (var i = 0; i < (columnar ? count : 1); i++) {
    encoder.writePresent();
    encoder.writeBytes(value);
  }
  if (layers == 1) {
    final empty = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
      ..writeVarint(0)
      ..writeVarint(0)
      ..writeEnd();
    encoder.writeVarint(2);
    for (var i = 0; i < (columnar ? count : 1); i++) {
      encoder.writePresent();
      encoder.writeBytes(empty.bytes());
    }
  }
  encoder.writeEnd();
  return encoder.bytes();
}

Uint8List page(Uint8List columns) {
  final encoder = sdk.LuxoEncoder();
  for (final value in [1, 1, 10])
    encoder.writeSvarint(sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(value));
  return Uint8List.fromList([...columns, ...encoder.bytes()]);
}

Node outputNode(int layers, {bool lists = false, int jsonDepth = 128}) {
  var value = Node(
    metadata: sdk.Selected.value(jsonValue(jsonDepth)),
    children: const sdk.Selected.value([]),
  );
  for (var i = 1; i < layers; i++) {
    value = lists
        ? Node(children: sdk.Selected.value([value]))
        : Node(child: sdk.Selected.value(value));
  }
  return value;
}

NodeInput inputNode(int layers, {bool lists = false, int jsonDepth = 128}) {
  var value = NodeInput(metadata: jsonValue(jsonDepth), children: []);
  for (var i = 1; i < layers; i++) {
    value = lists ? NodeInput(children: [value]) : NodeInput(child: value);
  }
  return value;
}

void main() {
  for (final mode in sdk.TransportMode.values) {
    test(
      'generated HTTP checks model writes and read64/read65: $mode',
      () async {
        var sent = 0;
        final client = LuxoClient(
          sdk.HttpTransport(
            'http://example.test/luxo',
            options: sdk.TransportOptions(mode: mode),
            client: MockClient((request) async {
              sent++;
              final nodes = requestControl(request, mode);
              return mode == sdk.TransportMode.json
                  ? http.Response(
                      jsonEncode({
                        'data': {'node': jsonNode(nodes)},
                      }),
                      200,
                    )
                  : http.Response.bytes(containerBytes(nodes), 200);
            }),
          ),
        );
        addTearDown(client.close);
        await exerciseClient(client, mode, websocket: false);
        expect(sent, 6);
      },
    );
    test(
      'generated real WS checks model writes and isolates read65: $mode',
      () async {
        final client = LuxoClient(
          sdk.WsTransport(
            socketEndpoint,
            options: sdk.TransportOptions(mode: mode),
            autoReconnect: false,
          ),
        );
        addTearDown(client.close);
        await exerciseClient(client, mode, websocket: true);
      },
    );
  }
  test('typed model cycles fail without leaking depth into later writes', () {
    final outputs = <Node>[];
    final output = Node(children: sdk.Selected.value(outputs));
    outputs.add(output);
    final inputs = <NodeInput>[];
    final input = NodeInput(children: inputs);
    inputs.add(input);
    expect(() => output.toJson(), throwsFormatException);
    expect(() => input.toJson(), throwsFormatException);
    expect(() => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(output), throwsFormatException);
    expect(() => input.writeLuxo(sdk.LuxoEncoder()), throwsFormatException);
    outputs.clear();
    inputs.clear();
    expect(() => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(output), returnsNormally);
    expect(() => input.writeLuxo(sdk.LuxoEncoder()), returnsNormally);
  });
  for (final lists in [false, true]) {
    for (final layers in [63, 64]) {
      test(
        'generated model$layers JSON writing preserves JSON128 lists=$lists',
        () {
          final output = outputNode(layers, lists: lists);
          final input = inputNode(layers, lists: lists);
          expect(output.toJson(), isA<Map<String, Object?>>());
          expect(input.toJson(), isA<Map<String, Object?>>());
          expect(() => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(output), returnsNormally);
          expect(() => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(input), returnsNormally);
          expect(() => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON([output, output]), returnsNormally);
        },
      );
      test(
        'generated model$layers Binary writing accepts independent JSON128 lists=$lists',
        () {
          expect(
            () => inputNode(layers, lists: lists).writeLuxo(sdk.LuxoEncoder()),
            returnsNormally,
          );
        },
      );
    }
    test('output toJson rejects model65 lists=$lists', () {
      expect(
        () => outputNode(65, lists: lists).toJson(),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    });
    test('input toJson rejects model65 lists=$lists', () {
      expect(() => inputNode(65, lists: lists).toJson(), throwsFormatException);
    });
    test('generic model encoding rejects model65 lists=$lists', () {
      expect(
        () => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(outputNode(65, lists: lists, jsonDepth: 0)),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
      expect(
        () => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(inputNode(65, lists: lists, jsonDepth: 0)),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    });
    test('Binary model writing rejects model65 lists=$lists', () {
      expect(
        () => inputNode(65, lists: lists).writeLuxo(sdk.LuxoEncoder()),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    });
  }
  test(
    'parameter projection preserves typed children without copying their graph',
    () {
      final child = inputNode(64, jsonDepth: 0);
      final input = NodeInput(child: child, children: [child]);
      final projected = input.toLuxoParameters();
      expect(identical(projected['child'], child), isTrue);
      expect(identical((projected['children'] as List).single, child), isTrue);
    },
  );
  test('JSON128 values retain their identity in typed projections and JSON129 fails', () {
    final raw = jsonValue(128);
    final input = NodeInput(metadata: raw);
    final output = Node(metadata: sdk.Selected.value(raw));
    expect(identical(input.toJson()['metadata'], raw), isTrue);
    expect(identical(output.toJson()['metadata'], raw), isTrue);
    expect(() => inputNode(1, jsonDepth: 129).toJson(), throwsFormatException);
    expect(() => outputNode(1, jsonDepth: 129).toJson(), throwsFormatException);
  });
  test('JSON projections count every Map implementation without copying', () {
    for (final layers in [128, 129]) {
      Object? raw;
      for (var i = 0; i < layers; i++) raw = <Object?, Object?>{'next': raw};
      final input = NodeInput(metadata: raw);
      final output = Node(metadata: sdk.Selected.value(raw));
      if (layers == 128) {
        expect(identical(input.toJson()['metadata'], raw), isTrue);
        expect(identical(output.toJson()['metadata'], raw), isTrue);
      } else {
        expect(() => input.toJson(), throwsFormatException);
        expect(() => output.toJson(), throwsFormatException);
      }
    }
    expect(
      () => NodeInput(metadata: <Object?, Object?>{1: true}).toJson(),
      throwsFormatException,
    );
    expect(
      () =>
          Node(metadata: sdk.Selected.value(<Object?, Object?>{1: true}))
              .toJson(),
      throwsFormatException,
    );
  });
  test(
    'opaque JSON budgets include every container of embedded typed models',
    () {
      final typed = outputNode(1);
      expect(() => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(typed), returnsNormally);
      expect(
        () => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(typed, opaque: true),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
      expect(
        () => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(Node(metadata: sdk.Selected.value(typed))),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    },
  );
  test('decoded model lists retain growable results', () {
    final columns = wireNode(1, columnar: true);
    final values = decodeColumnarNode(columns);
    values.add(values.first);
    expect(values, hasLength(2));
    final items = decodePaginatedNode(page(columns)).items;
    items.add(items.first);
    expect(items, hasLength(2));
    final model = Node.fromJson({
      'children': [
        {'metadata': null},
      ],
    }).children.value!;
    model.add(model.first);
    expect(model, hasLength(2));
    final input = NodeInput.fromJson({
      'children': [
        {'metadata': null},
      ],
    }).children!;
    input.add(input.first);
    expect(input, hasLength(2));
  });
  test('nullable Binary JSON preserves literal null and field selection', () {
    final value = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode('null'));
    final row = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
      ..writeVarint(0)
      ..writeVarint(3)
      ..writePresent()
      ..writeBytes(value)
      ..writeEnd();
    final decoded = decodeNode(sdk.LuxoDecoder(row.bytes()));
    expect(decoded.metadata.isSelected, isTrue);
    expect(decoded.metadata.value, isNull);
    final column = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
      ..writeVarint(1)
      ..writeVarint(0)
      ..writeVarint(3)
      ..writePresent()
      ..writeBytes(value)
      ..writeEnd();
    expect(decodeColumnarNode(column.bytes()).single.metadata.value, isNull);
    final absent = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
      ..writeVarint(0)
      ..writeEnd();
    expect(
      decodeNode(sdk.LuxoDecoder(absent.bytes())).metadata.isSelected,
      isFalse,
    );
  });
  for (final lists in [false, true]) {
    for (final layers in [63, 64]) {
      test(
        'direct JSON and input accept model$layers with JSON128 lists=$lists',
        () {
          final source = jsonNode(layers, lists: lists);
          expect(Node.fromJson(source), isA<Node>());
          expect(NodeInput.fromJson(source), isA<NodeInput>());
          expect(Node.$fromJsonItem(source), isA<Node>());
        },
      );
      test(
        'Binary row, columnar and page accept model$layers lists=$lists',
        () {
          expect(
            decodeNode(sdk.LuxoDecoder(wireNode(layers, lists: lists))),
            isA<Node>(),
          );
          final columns = wireNode(
            layers,
            columnar: true,
            lists: lists,
            count: 2,
          );
          expect(decodeColumnarNode(columns), hasLength(2));
          expect(decodePaginatedNode(page(columns)).items, hasLength(2));
        },
      );
    }
    test('direct JSON rejects model65 lists=$lists', () {
      final source = jsonNode(65, lists: lists);
      expect(() => Node.fromJson(source), throwsFormatException);
    });
    test('direct input rejects model65 lists=$lists', () {
      final source = jsonNode(65, lists: lists);
      expect(() => NodeInput.fromJson(source), throwsFormatException);
    });
    test('direct JSON list item rejects model65 lists=$lists', () {
      final source = jsonNode(65, lists: lists);
      expect(() => Node.$fromJsonItem(source), throwsFormatException);
    });
    test('Binary row rejects model65 lists=$lists', () {
      expect(
        () => decodeNode(sdk.LuxoDecoder(wireNode(65, lists: lists))),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    });
    test('Binary columnar rejects model65 lists=$lists', () {
      expect(
        () => decodeColumnarNode(wireNode(65, columnar: true, lists: lists)),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    });
    test('Binary page rejects model65 lists=$lists', () {
      expect(
        () => decodePaginatedNode(
          page(wireNode(65, columnar: true, lists: lists)),
        ),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    });
  }
  test('outer model consumes one object level and siblings reset depth', () {
    expect(Container.fromJson({'node': jsonNode(63)}), isA<Container>());
    expect(
      () => Container.fromJson({'node': jsonNode(64)}),
      throwsFormatException,
    );
    final row = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
      ..writeVarint(0)
      ..writeVarint(1)
      ..writeBytes(wireNode(63))
      ..writeEnd();
    expect(decodeContainer(sdk.LuxoDecoder(row.bytes())), isA<Container>());
    final tooDeep = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
      ..writeVarint(0)
      ..writeVarint(1)
      ..writeBytes(wireNode(64))
      ..writeEnd();
    expect(
      () => decodeContainer(sdk.LuxoDecoder(tooDeep.bytes())),
      throwsFormatException,
    );
    expect(
      Node.fromJson({
        'children': [jsonNode(63), jsonNode(63)],
      }).children.value,
      hasLength(2),
    );
  });
  test(
    'cyclic direct JSON reports FormatException and later calls recover',
    () {
      final source = <String, dynamic>{};
      source['child'] = source;
      expect(() => Node.fromJson(source), throwsFormatException);
      expect(() => NodeInput.fromJson(source), throwsFormatException);
      expect(Node.fromJson({'metadata': jsonValue(128)}), isA<Node>());
      expect(
        NodeInput.fromJson({'metadata': jsonValue(128)}),
        isA<NodeInput>(),
      );
    },
  );
  test(
    'generic JSON129 remains independent and empty model lists are valid',
    () {
      expect(
        () => Node.fromJson({'metadata': jsonValue(129)}),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
      expect(
        () => NodeInput.fromJson({'metadata': jsonValue(129)}),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
      final empty = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
        ..writeVarint(0)
        ..writeVarint(0)
        ..writeEnd();
      expect(decodeColumnarNode(empty.bytes()), isEmpty);
      expect(decodePaginatedNode(page(empty.bytes())).items, isEmpty);
    },
  );
  test('Binary JSON129 is rejected inside an otherwise valid model64', () {
    expect(
      () => decodeNode(sdk.LuxoDecoder(wireNode(64, jsonDepth: 129))),
      throwsFormatException,
    );
    final columns = wireNode(64, columnar: true, jsonDepth: 129);
    expect(() => decodeColumnarNode(columns), throwsFormatException);
    expect(() => decodePaginatedNode(page(columns)), throwsFormatException);
  });
}

List<int> containerBytes(int nodes) {
  final value = wireNode(nodes);
  return (sdk.LuxoEncoder()
        ..writeVarint(0)
        ..writeVarint(1)
        ..writeBytes(value)
        ..writeEnd())
      .bytes();
}

int requestControl(http.Request request, sdk.TransportMode mode) {
  if (mode == sdk.TransportMode.json)
    return (jsonDecode(request.body) as Map)['control'] as int;
  final decoder = sdk.LuxoDecoder(request.bodyBytes);
  expect(decoder.readUnsigned(), 1);
  expect(decoder.readBytes(), isNotEmpty);
  var nodes = 1;
  while (decoder.nextField()) {
    if (decoder.fieldID == 1) {
      decoder.readBytes();
    } else {
      expect(decoder.fieldID, 2);
      nodes = decoder.readInt().toInt();
    }
  }
  decoder.checkComplete();
  return nodes;
}

Future<void> exerciseClient(
  LuxoClient client,
  sdk.TransportMode mode, {
  required bool websocket,
}) async {
  final selection = LuxoClient.$prepareSelection('node{metadata}');
  Future<Container> read(int nodes, NodeInput value) => client.read(
    value: value,
    control: sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(nodes),
    $selectionPlan: selection,
  );
  Matcher failure(String label) => throwsA(
    isA<sdk.LuxoError>().having((error) => error.error, 'error', label),
  );
  final badInput = mode == sdk.TransportMode.binary
      ? throwsFormatException
      : failure('ConfigError');
  final badOutput = mode == sdk.TransportMode.binary
      ? throwsFormatException
      : failure(websocket ? 'DecodeError' : 'ParseError');
  expect(await read(1, inputNode(64)), isA<Container>());
  await expectLater(read(1, inputNode(65)), badInput);
  expect(await read(63, inputNode(1)), isA<Container>());
  await expectLater(read(64, inputNode(1)), badOutput);
  final bad = expectLater(read(64, inputNode(1)), badOutput);
  final good = read(1, inputNode(1));
  await bad;
  expect(await good, isA<Container>());
  expect(await read(1, inputNode(1)), isA<Container>());
}
